paras: Ten payer pipes reach the factions, and most cross faction lines: no donor class belongs to one faction. The matrix marks where documented money, stakes or pay reach a faction's people. Each faction's monetary roster lists the donors, amounts and the people they reach. Absent links are findings. None of the reports found a document joining Srpska pay to a midterm decision, Gulf money to a chip or Russia decision, GEO to a contract award, pro-Israel donors to a position on the Epstein files, or Thiel and Musk to the PERM suspensions. The pattern is conflict of roles with timing and fit, not proof of exchange.
title: Money across factions
